about.title: Engineer first. Partner always.
about.body: I'm Ahmad, a software engineer focused on AI. I've built retrieval systems for Arabic texts, medical prediction tools, luxury mobile apps and robotics prototypes. I work directly with founders and teams — clear communication, honest timelines and software that's built to last.
about.pageLead: An AI-focused software engineer who turns ideas into working products — AI systems, websites and mobile apps.
about.story1: I started out building hardware and robotics projects, which taught me to think about the whole system: not just the code, but the people using it and the environment it runs in.
about.story2: Today I focus on AI — retrieval-augmented systems, machine-learning models and LLM-powered features — and on the web and mobile products that put them in users' hands. I'm fluent in Arabic and English, so I build bilingual, right-to-left products properly from the start.
about.story3: Clients work with me directly. No account managers, no hand-offs: one person who understands both the business goal and the technical detail.
